University of Melbourne, Cassidy Bequest Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia from talented undergraduate or graduate students studying Music, Theatre, Production or Music Theatre. The scholarship aims to award talented students. The selected students will receive a single payment of between approximately AUD 1,000 to AUD 5,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be an Australian/domestic student or an International student
Be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate course in Music, Theatre, Production or Music Theatre in the Faculty of Fine Arts and Music
The selected students will receive a single payment of between approximately AUD 1,000 to AUD 5,000.
